description: This file defines the Console API for Zephyr OS, including function prototypes for initializing, reading from, writing to, and handling console input/output, as well as related functions for line input.
external_methods: ssize_t console_write(void *dummy, const void *buf, size_t size)

methods.name: console_init
methods.description: Initializes the console device for pull-style access and buffered output.

methods.name: console_read
methods.description: Reads data from the console into a buffer.

methods.name: console_write
methods.description: Writes data to the console from a buffer.

methods.name: console_getchar
methods.description: Retrieves the next character from the console input buffer, blocking if no characters are available.

methods.name: console_putchar
methods.description: Outputs a character to the console buffer asynchronously.

methods.name: console_getline
methods.description: Returns the next line from the console input buffer, blocking until a full line is available.
